newsitem.title: USA: Cephalon to place $30 mln in convertibles.
newsitem.headline: Cephalon to place $30 mln in convertibles.

text.p: Cephalon Inc said on Thursday that it has an agreement to issue, in a private placement, $30 million of senior convertible notes.
Cephalon said it plans to use the proceeds of the private placement for general purposes, which may include funding potential technology acquisitions.
The notes are convertible into common stock of the company at a six percent discount to a market price formula at the time of conversion.
Cephalon said it expects to initially register 1.43 million shares of common stock, related to the offering.
Cephalon currently has about 24.5 million shares of common stock outstanding.
Earlier, Cephalon said Schering-Plough Corp will discontinue funding the companies' research collaboration to develop compounds for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
